title: Causal State-Dependent Local Projections
abstract: arXiv:2605.05404v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: State-dependent local projections (LPs) are widely used to study how causal effects vary as a function of economic states, but shock exogeneity alone does not identify this response function. We show that identification follows when the underlying conditional mean is linear in the shock with a state-dependent coefficient, a condition satisfied in canonical micro-macro environments, including first-order perturbation solutions of heterogeneous-agent and macro-finance models. Even then, standard linear-interaction LPs generally recover only a projection of the response function, motivating LPs with nonparametric state dependence. We develop a sieve estimator and establish pointwise and uniform inference for micro-macro panels, where a distinctive challenge is that the estimator can converge at different rates across the state space. translated_title: 因果状态依赖局部投影
translated_abstract: 状态依赖局部投影（LPs）被广泛用于研究因果效应如何随经济状态变化而变化，但仅凭冲击的外生性并不能识别这一响应函数。我们证明，当潜在的条件均值对冲击呈线性且系数依赖状态时，识别即可成立，这一条件在典型的微观-宏观环境中得到满足，包括异质性主体模型和宏观金融模型的一阶摄动解。即便如此，标准的线性交互局部投影通常只能恢复响应函数的一个投影，这促使采用具有非参数状态依赖性的局部投影。我们开发了一种筛估计量，并为微观-宏观面板建立了逐点和一致推断，其中一个独特的挑战是估计量在状态空间的不同区域可能以不同的速度收敛。应用于企业投资时，该方法揭示了企业投资对货币政策冲击的驼峰形响应……
tldr: 本文提出具有非参数状态依赖性的因果局部投影方法，证明了在条件均值对冲击线性且系数状态依赖时的识别条件，开发了适用于微观-宏观面板的筛估计量及逐点与一致推断，并应用于企业投资发现其对货币政策冲击呈驼峰形响应。
en_tdlr: This paper develops causal local projections with nonparametric state dependence, establishes identification under state-dependent linear conditional means, provides a sieve estimator with pointwise and uniform inference for micro-macro panels, and uncovers a hump-shaped firm investment response to monetary policy shocks.
